result.description:
We are a growing Australian business group operating across wholesale distribution, event services and education. As our organisation continues to expand and diversify, we are seeking an experienced and highly organised Office Manager to oversee our administrative and operational functions and support the continued growth of the business.

This is a senior, hands-on role suited to a proactive professional who thrives in a dynamic environment. The successful candidate will be responsible for leading office operations, developing efficient business systems, coordinating multiple business functions, and supporting strategic initiatives that drive organisational growth and operational excellence.


Key Responsibilities

- Lead and oversee the day-to-day office operations across multiple business divisions.
- Develop, implement and continuously improve office procedures, administrative systems and operational workflows.
- Coordinate communication and workflow across departments to ensure efficient and effective business operations.
- Identify opportunities for continuous improvement and implement initiatives that increase efficiency, streamline processes and support sustainable business growth.
- Lead the implementation, optimisation and integration of enterprise business systems, digital workflow platforms and business automation technologies.
- Coordinate supplier relationships, purchasing activities and operational logistics.
- Prepare management reports, operational documentation and business performance information to support informed decision-making.
- Assist with budgeting, resource planning and business administration.
- Coordinate recruitment, onboarding, staff administration and HR documentation.
- Maintain company policies, compliance records and organisational documentation.
- Support directors in delivering strategic projects, organisational change initiatives and business expansion activities.
- Establish scalable administrative systems and operational processes to support future growth.

Skills & Experience

The successful applicant will demonstrate:

- A minimum of three years' experience in an Office Manager, Operations Coordinator, Business Operations or similar management role.
- Demonstrated experience managing office operations within a growing, multi-site or multi-faceted business environment.
- Proven experience implementing or improving enterprise business systems, ERP, CRM or other integrated business management platforms.
- Experience leading business process improvement, workflow optimisation and automation initiatives.
- Strong organisational, project coordination and time management skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously.
- Experience developing and maintaining business policies, procedures and operational documentation.
- Excellent communication, stakeholder management and interpersonal skills.
- High-level computer literacy, including Microsoft 365 and cloud-based business applications.
- Experience with bookkeeping processes, reporting and business administration.
- Strong analytical, problem-solving and decision-making abilities.
- A proactive, adaptable and solutions-focused approach with a commitment to continuous improvement.

What We Offer

This is an excellent opportunity to join a growing organisation where you will play a key role in strengthening business operations, implementing scalable systems and supporting the continued growth of multiple business divisions.

If you are an experienced Office Manager looking for a challenging and rewarding role where you can make a genuine impact, we encourage you to apply by submitting your resume and a cover letter outlining your relevant experience.

About WCHN
Join the Women's and Children's Health Network (WCHN), South Australia's leading provider of care for women, babies, children and young people. We're shaping the future of healthcare through compassion, innovation and excellence - with our communities at the heart of everything we do.

What WCHN Can Offer You

Access to salary packaging benefits of up to $9,010 each FBT year for living expenses (e.g. mortgage, rent, utilities, groceries), plus an additional $2,650 each FBT year for meal entertainment expenses.

About the role

The Business Systems Officer manages projects supporting financial, ICT, and administrative operations within the service. The Business Systems Officer monitors business data and KPIs, maintains financial and statistical data of budget performance, and oversees EMR use by ensuring accurate data capture and user support training.

Please look to address the essential minimum requirements highlighted in the attached Role Descriptor within a 2 page cover letter.

Key duties of the role

Support the Business Manager to ensure accounting procedures are implemented.

Liaise with financial services, payroll service, and other cost centre managers to ensure correct allocation of expenses.

Support the Business Manager to develop and implement improved activity reporting and resource management.

Participate in budget processes, ensuring deadlines are achieved.

Support the Business Manager in providing a range of financial and activity reporting to Managers to develop effective key performance indicators.

Skills and Experience

Experience in managing a range of data management projects that have an impact on financial operations.

Experience in undertaking business analysis, developing strategies, and providing concise written reports.

Experience in developing, implementing, and reporting on key performance indicators.

Working knowledge of Oracle Corporate Systems and SHARP.

Ability to meet deadlines and work with minimal supervision.

JRT Group is a family-owned and operated throughout in Central Queensland. For over 20 years, JRT Group has shown a passion and a dedication for our work that has helped us to gain large numbers of satisfied clients. We offer everything from bulk earthworks to plant hire to our clients for a broad range of projects across the region. Our commitment to quality work and to each client we work with has made us one of the premier civil contracting companies in Central Queensland.

JRT Group is seeking qualified Plumbers to join their team. The Plumber (General) is responsible for the installation, testing, commissioning, maintenance, and repair of plumbing systems across residential, commercial, and civil infrastructure projects. The role requires trade-level expertise, regulatory compliance, and independent judgement consistent with ANZSCO Skill Level 3.

Main Duties and Responsibilities include but are not limited to:
Install, repair, and maintain water supply, drainage, sewerage, stormwater, and gas systems
Interpret plumbing drawings, specifications, and building codes
Perform pressure testing, fault diagnosis, and system commissioning
Ensure all works comply with Australian Standards, NCC, and WHS requirements
Liaise with site supervisors, engineers, and other trades
Supervise apprentices or trade assistants when required
Maintain accurate service records and compliance documentation
Respond to emergency plumbing repairs as required

To be considered for this role, you must have the following:
Trade qualification equivalent to Certificate III in Plumbing
Relevant state plumbing licence or registration (or eligibility)
White Card (Construction Induction)
Minimum 2 years of experience in the same field
Good working knowledge of water supply, heating, and ventilation systems
Proficiency in reading blueprints and using plumbing tools
Strong critical thinking and troubleshooting skills
Good listening and communication skills
Good time management and organisational skills
Self-motivated, organised, punctual, and reliable
Must have great work ethics

If you meet the above criteria and would like to be considered for this position, please apply now!
Salary: Between $79,499 and $82,000 per annum + Super
